name: Lovebugz
source:
You're just a human garbage man, but one fateful morning you accidentally ask a giant housefly out on a date. Now the world will be forever changed and it's up to you to keep everything together.

[from [url=https://colethebug.itch.io/lovebugz]itch.io[/url]]
